description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.
Specifies whether to enable the health check.

description.zh: 正常状态码（健康检查协议为HTTP时必填）
description.en: The expected status code, which is required if the health check protocol is HTTP.
The unique ID of the gateway.
The healthy threshold of the health check.

description.zh: 健康检查域名（健康检查协议为HTTP时选填）
description.en: The health check domain name, which is optional if the health check protocol is HTTP.

description.zh: 健康检查路径（健康检查协议为HTTP时必填）
description.en: The health check path, which is required if the health check protocol is HTTP.
The interval at which the health check is performed.

description.zh:
健康检查协议，目前支持：
- HTTP
- TCP
description.en:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

*   HTTP
*   TCP

description.zh: 健康检查响应超时时间（秒）
description.en: The timeout period of responses to the health check. Unit: seconds.
The unhealthy threshold of the health check.

title.zh: 更新服务健康检查策略

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-service-check --service-id 12 --gateway-unique-id gw-8d410698bd7f4628ab76b0000072dd1d --check true --expected-statuses 200 --protocol HTTP --timeout 5 --interval 2 --healthy-threshold 2 --unhealthy-threshold 2 --http-path /healthz --http-host example.com --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateGatewayServiceCheck --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-8d410698bd7f4628ab76b0000072dd1d' --HttpPath '/healthz' --UnhealthyThreshold 2 --Timeout 5 --HttpHost 'example.com' --HealthyThreshold 2 --Check true --ExpectedStatuses '[200]' --AcceptLanguage zh --Protocol HTTP --ServiceId 12 --Interval 2
